globalNews.title: Door was locked at Pakistan hospital where fire killed 14 babies, witnesses say
globalNews.summary: A hospital official told the BBC that the door to the ward was not locked, but manned with security guards, to protect the babies.

globalNews.title: Canada announces 'dollar-for-dollar' retaliatory tariffs on US as high as 50%
globalNews.summary: The latest escalation in an ongoing trade war between the US and Canada will see new levies on goods from steel to furniture, fresh tuna and makeup.

globalNews.title: German airport worker dies of malaria after 'mosquito arrives on plane'
globalNews.summary: Five other airport workers are also receiving treatment following the rare outbreak at German's busiest airport.

globalNews.title: Far-right Israeli lawmaker damages Palestinian memorial with sledgehammer
globalNews.summary: Zvi Sukkot's actions have drawn widespread condemnation, including from Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.

globalNews.title: Libyan who was cleared after Lockerbie bombing trial dies aged 70
globalNews.summary: A Facebook post by Libyan Airlines announced the death of Al Amin Khalifah Fhimah and expressed the company's condolences to his family.

cryptoNews.title: SEC’s proposed crypto rules probably won’t spark new ICO boom
cryptoNews.summary: The SEC’s ‘regulation crypto assets’ proposals could create early-round FOMO. But some tokens may still fall into the no-man’s land between security and non-security.

cryptoNews.title: Students want crypto classes but learn on social media: OKX survey
cryptoNews.summary: A separate review found only about 28% of accredited US business schools offered blockchain courses, despite strong demand in the OKX poll.

cryptoNews.title: Bernstein forecasts Bitcoin to reclaim $125K by late 2026 ahead of cycle peak
cryptoNews.summary: Bernstein expects Bitcoin to reclaim $125,000 by late 2026, before reaching $300,000 in 2029 under its base case, with a bull case of $500,000.

cryptoNews.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
cryptoNews.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

cryptoNews.title: Taurus links digital asset platforms to Swift’s blockchain ledger
cryptoNews.summary: Taurus expects first institutional clients to connect in days, with initial DLT transactions through its platforms expected within weeks.

aiNews.title: QueryStory wants you to believe what AI is telling you
aiNews.summary: The startup came out of stealth with $6 million in seed funding and a plan to use LLMs and cybersecurity know-how to make AI queries coherent.

aiNews.title: Arga Labs is building a better way to train enterprise AI agents
aiNews.summary: Arga has raised $10 million in a seed funding round that was led by General Catalyst, with participation from Box Group, Emergence, Gradient and SV Angel.

aiNews.title: Hearing tech startup Legato emerges from stealth with $12M and a peek at its AI hearing glasses
aiNews.summary: The glasses, called Legato Frames, integrate the company’s patented hearing-assistance technology into the arms of eyewear frames.

aiNews.title: Runable hits $21M to bet AI agents can go from building businesses to growing them
aiNews.summary: Runable says 60%–70% of its 1 trillion-plus token usage in the last 90 days came from paying customers.

aiNews.title: India’s Ringg gets backing from Peak XV as it pushes voice AI past the phone call
aiNews.summary: Ringg has raised $10 million from Peak XV as a part of its Series A extension.
